about: S4 task 8.7 / S4-IR-02: the task map tools/closeout-check.js resolves carry-forward schedules against. Precedence comes from the sprint preconditions (phases) and from the dependencies each checklist STATES (after), never from how task ids sort. A node with no stated dependency is not assumed to follow anything in its phase. partOf ties a block or subtask to its task, and it inherits that task's dependencies. Edited by hand; every entry cites its source. Until review.status is "reviewed", the closeout check carries nothing forward.

review.note: Approved by the owner in chat together with tools/carry-forward-schedule.json, including eb's five proposals: BC-02 medium; S4-IR-05 before S5b task 4; the second-machine check by S5b task 4, medium, for the owner; iPhone unmeasured, medium; Android unmeasured, high. Committed unreviewed at dee978f. S5AA task 7.4 (2026-09-20, on the owner's decision 'Add the map'): the S5AA phase and its eleven nodes were added by the S5AA session, sourced from S5AA_TASK_CHECKLIST.md's own preconditions and dependency diagram, together with the widening of TASK_ID in tools/closeout-check.js that lets an S5AA task id parse. tools/ is the plan owner's, so both are RELAYED to them for review rather than treated as reviewed: review.status is unchanged and still refers to the 2026-09-13 approval of everything that preceded this.
